svg.text: Three directions on a 32-unit grid. Flat fills only. Gold is the single accent.
The prism that doubles as a P

text.tspan: Chosen. A solid P whose counter
is the prism; the navy tile keeps
the gold on navy at every size.
One-colour drops the tile, keeps the P.
One beam in, three ticket notches
out. Strong at 64; the notches and

Vector sheet. 16 px cells are true 16 px. Raster checks at 16/24/32/64 were made with Sharp; no browser was available in the build session.
